name: Spectrum canyon
description: The hi-fi analyser stood up into a city: LED columns repeated forever across a reflective floor, flown through at bar height with peak caps floating over them. The bars read a curve through the six band followers, mirrored so the sub band runs down the middle of the canyon.

bars.description: Columns before the frequency sweep repeats across the field.

height.description: World height of a full-scale bar. Tall enough that the near columns leave the top of the frame.

thickness.description: Bar width as a fraction of the spacing. Near 1 the columns touch and the field becomes a wall.

speed.description: How fast the camera flies down the canyon.

wave.description: Rate of the phase travelling down the depth axis. 0 makes every row identical and the field reads as one solid ridge.

detail.description: Per-bar deviation from the six-point curve, scaled by onset. 0 gives the honest interpolation; past ~0.7 neighbouring bars disagree more than the music does.

tint.description: Blends the green/amber/red ladder toward the project palette. 0 is a literal hi-fi meter, 1 is the palette alone and loses the meaning the colours carry.

reflect.description: Strength of the reflection in the floor.
